_about: Exam requirements for Standard Exam mode. Every value must match the official notification. Set is_placeholder to false only after checking the value against the PDF, and record the page in notes.

profiles.notes: Signature: JPG/JPEG only. File size 30 to 49 KB. Minimum 140 x 60 px and minimum 100 DPI. Black ink on white paper, running handwriting (not block capitals). Source: CEN No. 06/2026, para 14.5.1, page 23. The min pixel size is not enforced by the resize; check it on the scanned image.
